meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文字、网页或设计稿变成带动画和字幕的视频，并支持批量出片与预览
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常要做宣传片、讲解片或短视频，又不想逐帧手工剪辑
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need promo, explainer, or social videos without frame-by-frame editing.

howto.what: 装上后,凡是做、改、动画化或渲染视频、动画、动效图的请求,Claude 都会先读这个入口:读取已有项目状态,新项目先跑意图访谈并写出 BRIEF.md,再挑选并安装对应工作流,由 HyperFrames 用 HTML 渲染成片。
howto.when: 当你要求制作、修改、动画化或渲染视频/动画/动效图(如宣传片、解说、字幕剪辑等),或要检查、预览、发布已有 HyperFrames 项目时触发。

say.text: 帮我用这个网站做一个产品宣传视频
say.note: 先跑意图访谈,再路由到对应工作流

say.text: 把这个 GitHub PR 做成一段解说视频
say.note: 路由到 PR 转视频工作流

say.text: 检查和预览我这个 HyperFrames 项目
say.note: 只执行该操作,不跑意图访谈

howto.what_en: Once installed, any request to make, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic goes through this entry point: it resumes project state, runs an intent interview and writes BRIEF.md for fresh work, installs the owning workflow, and renders via HyperFrames HTML.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to make, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic (promo, explainer, captioned clip, etc.), or to inspect, preview, or publish an existing HyperFrames project.

say_en.text: Make a product promo video from this website
say_en.note: Runs the intent interview, then routes to a workflow

say_en.text: Turn this GitHub PR into an explainer video
Check and preview my HyperFrames project
say_en.note: Performs only that operation, no intent interview
